reason: B is the stronger proposal because it specifies a substantive high-entropy diboride intervention, feasible HEBM/SPS processing, a concrete composition, relevant controls, and is supported by prior demonstrations of single-phase formation and improved hardness/oxidation behavior. Its liquid-metal claim remains weakly grounded and configurational entropy does not itself guarantee easier densification, but A is even more speculative regarding sub-1700 °C pressureless densification and protection by a Si-derived glass in a liquid-metal bath.
